# IT WHITE

> IT WHITE is a technology consultancy and product engineering company that designs, implements, and supports internal systems, CRM control, AI tools, integrations, analytics dashboards, and custom product solutions for business processes.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://itwhite.ru/) - IT WHITE positioning, products, methodology, diagnostics, and contact form.
- [Solutions](https://itwhite.ru/solutions/) - the canonical registry of business control problems and solution contours.
- [Products](https://itwhite.ru/products/) - product states, public evidence, and explicit claim boundaries.
- [Verified work](https://itwhite.ru/work/) - owned production contours separated from client case claims.
- [Company](https://itwhite.ru/about/) - team responsibilities and evidence rules.
- [Insights](https://itwhite.ru/insights/) - editorial research, clearly separated from delivered client work.
- [Process automation](https://itwhite.ru/process-automation/) - automation of repeatable business processes with explicit owners, events, integrations, exception handling, and recovery paths.
- [Business process audit](https://itwhite.ru/business-process-audit/) - process map, loss points, risks, solution architecture, and preliminary budget.
- [Formats and pricing](https://itwhite.ru/formats/) - Diagnose, Launch, and Operate entry formats for process diagnostics, first control contours, and support.
- [IT WHITE Control](https://itwhite.ru/it-white-control/) - flagship control system for leads, SLA, responsible owners, and next actions.
- [Lost leads control](https://itwhite.ru/lost-leads/) - decision guide for finding and controlling lead loss between channels, CRM, owners, and SLA.
- [Security and data](https://itwhite.ru/security-data/) - access, data boundaries, audit trails, backup, recovery, and AI data handling.
- [CRM automation](https://itwhite.ru/crm-automation/) - CRM automation, lead control, SLA monitoring, notifications, and integrations.
- [Controlled AI automation](https://itwhite.ru/ai-automation/) - AI tools embedded in sales, support, operations, document workflows, and knowledge systems with verification and human responsibility.
- [Custom product development](https://itwhite.ru/custom-product-development/) - Internal platforms, client portals, micro-SaaS MVPs, and custom product solutions.
- [Bitrix24 automation](https://itwhite.ru/bitrix24-automation/) - Bitrix24 integrations, webhooks, robots, external logic, and AI lead control.
- [Internal tools](https://itwhite.ru/internal-tools/) - Dashboards, internal panels, service interfaces, calculators, and operational tools.
- [Avito analytics](https://itwhite.ru/avito-analytics/) - Avito demand analytics, geographic demand, CRM connection, and advertising opportunity detection.
- [Demand and attribution](https://itwhite.ru/seo-support/) - search demand connected to pages, analytics, leads, and CRM attribution.
- [AI and automation implementation library](https://itwhite.ru/cases/) - 50 sourced, industry-specific implementation scenarios with process design, human control, integrations, KPIs, risks, and evidence links. These are editorial research scenarios, not client claims.

## Products and access boundaries

- Avito Geo Demand - internal geographic demand analytics contour; no public product URL is currently claimed.
- [Telegram Multiaccount](https://tg.itwhite.ru) - unified workspace for multiple Telegram accounts and dialogue control.
- [CRM Lead Control](https://bot.itwhite.ru/admin) - private authenticated control surface for unprocessed leads in Bitrix24.

- Project discussion: https://t.me/rgvldi

## Preferred description

IT WHITE finds process breaks between sales, communications, CRM, data, and employee actions. The team designs and implements systems that return business processes under control.

## Editorial integrity

- Client work is labeled as a client case only when it was delivered by IT WHITE.
- The implementation library contains public research scenarios and cites external sources.
- Illustrative figures and demo interfaces are explicitly marked and are not presented as client metrics.
